steps.title: Placing the system on a flat table.
lines: Ensure your device is powered off before proceeding. Failure to do so may result in electrical shock or damage to the device.
Place the system on a flat stable surface.
The Cover Plates will ONLY work with the New Nintendo 3DS. They are not compatible with New Nintendo 3DS XL or any other Nintendo system.

steps.title: Unscrewing the back cover plate.
lines: Use a size #0 phillips-head screwdriver to loosen the screws from the back cover plate. The screws are attached to the cover, so they will not come out completely.

steps.title: Prying up the back cover plate.
lines: Use the nub on the end of the stylus , a fingernail or a plastic opening tool to gently pry on the small slots on each side near the L and R buttons. Once the cover plate begins to separate from the system, gently remove it.

steps.title: Prying the front cover plate.
lines: Use the nub on the end of the stylus , a fingernail, or a plastic opening tool to gently pry on the small slots on each side near the L and R buttons. Once the cover plate begins to separate from the system, gently remove it.

steps.title: Attaching the front cover plate.
lines: Attach the new front cover plate.

steps.title: Attaching the back cover plate.
lines: Attach the new back cover plate and tighten the two #0 phillips-head screws.
